Rising stars Zi Yu-Noraqilah enter first World Tour Final. The Malaysian pair won four matches against Chinese and Japanese rivals en route to the final.

Govt to appeal against ruling on nicotine exemption, says former minister. Dr Zaliha Mustafa, who was health minister in 2023, says the decision to exempt nicotine from the poisons list was a ‘bold step’ to help safeguard public health.
Pope Leo to visit France Sept 25-28. The pontiff’s visit follows his trip to Spain, reflecting a focus on secular European Catholic countries previously overlooked by his predecessor.
